name: Themesync
author: Jacek Becela
description: The themesync daemon in the Omarchy bar: whether the theme beacon is on the air and the watch is paired, the last request from the watch, and buttons to send the theme or the theme list again.

barWidget.description: A watch mark: lit while the beacon is on the air and a watch is paired, dimmed otherwise, red when the daemon needs attention. The panel shows the daemon's state and can send the theme or the theme list again.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the bar asks the daemon for its state over the local socket (one short message; the panel also refreshes when opened).

schema.label: Hide the mark while the daemon is not running
